full_lines.heard: Just landed in Montego Bay and not sure how you'll get to your hotel.
Three easy ways – a pre-booked private transfer, an authorized airport taxi, or a rental car.
Let's get you to the beach.
Quick note, Aurum Transfers is a travel affiliate brand, so if you book through our links, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. We don't run the rides ourselves. Our partners do.
One honest note, some clips here were filmed before Hurricane Melissa in October 2025, so a few places may look different today.
Welcome to Jamaica, and welcome to Sankster International.
Most visitors land right here in Montego Bay. Sanxter handles the large majority of the island's tourist arrivals.
It's the most convenient way in if you're heading to Montego Bay, Ocho Rios or Negrill.
This guide is for Sankster, Jamaica's other two international airports, Norman Manley in Kingston and Ian Fleming, near Ocho Rios, get their own arrival guides.
After Hurricane Melissa, the tourist board records that all international and domestic airports are open for commercial flights. Just check with your airline before you fly.
Is this your first time landing in Montego Bay? Tell us in the comments where you're staying.
Now the paperwork.
Before you fly, fill in the immigration and customs C5 form online. Sankster's operator says it has to be done before arrival.
You'll need a valid passport, and if you're not a resident, a return ticket.
British visitors don't need a visa and are usually granted entry for up to 90 days. Other nationalities should check the rules for their own passport.
At customs, declare anything prohibited or subject to duty and leave meat and dairy products at home.
and pack your own bags, never carry anything through customs for anyone else.
If this checklist just saved you a headache at the gate, tap like, it tells us to make more arrival guides like this one.
Through customs, here's how to get to your hotel.
Ka Haya, hotel shuttles and taxis are all in the ground transportation arrivals hall, just outside the customs area.
Option 1 is the calmest. A pre-booked private transfer. Your driver is arranged before you land so there's no hunting for a ride after a long flight.
On AurumTransfers.com, you can compare airport transfers from partner companies. The partner you choose runs the ride, so book once your flight times are fixed.
Option 2, an authorized airport taxi. Jutar and Jay Kal share an authorized airport taxi desk just outside the customs exit.
Canada advises using only authorised taxis with red and white P.P. plates and avoiding unmarked cars.
Option 3, a rental car. Jamaica drives on the left and inland roads can be narrow and winding, so stay on main roads where you can.
Which one are you picking? Transfer, taxi or rental? Tell us below and the transfer comparison link is in the description.
Now the best part, the beaches.
On Montego Bay's hip strip, Doctors Cave Beach is gentle, shallow and fine sand, and it's open to the public.
The hip strip itself, Gloucester Avenue, is a full mile of restaurants, entertainment and shopping.
Head west to Nagrill, the island's westernmost town with a 7-mile stretch of beach and cliffs overlooking the sea.
Long, calm sand on one side of town and cliffs dropping into clear water on the other.
Along the north coast, Ocho Rios is home to Duns River, one of the few waterfalls in the world that empties straight into the sea.
Water shoes make the climb safer and they are sold at the entrance if you forget yours.
Beach, Cliffs or Waterfall, hit subscribe and tell us which one is first on your list.
A few last tips, don't show off valuables and never leave anything in a parked car.
The currency is the Jamaican dollar. Cards work at hotels and tourist businesses, but cash machines are limited outside Kingston and Montego Bay.
After Melissa damaged water systems in the west and south, the Health Ministry advised treating water before drinking it, so check the latest advice when you arrive.
So the short version, fill in your C5 form before you fly, pick your ride before you land, transfer, authorize taxi or rental, then pick your coast.
